title: Concept: Dynamic evaluation of a runtime string in julia — review required
description: In julia, eval compiles a runtime string. Julia evaluates in a module context, so the string can define methods, import packages and call anything the module can reach. When the string contains a request value, the entire language is the attack surface.
applicability: julia services and data pipelines that accept expressions.
risk: Arbitrary code execution with process privileges; HIGH severity.
